summary_1line: Narada recounts how Indra kills Srinjaya’s gifted son Suvarnashthivin, Narada revives him, and Vyasa urges grieving Yudhishthira to fulfill kingly duty.

image_candidates.scene_text: A tiger sent by Indra leaps upon the five-year-old prince playing by the river Bhagirathi while his nurse screams in terror.
King Srinjaya cradles the blood-covered body of his son on the forest floor as grieving queens gather around him.
The sage Narada appears before the mourning king and restores the lifeless child to life by divine power.
